articles.summary: Crowne Plaza by IHG Hotels & Resorts, one of the world’s largest premium hotel brands and a pioneer in blended travel, today announces the opening of Crowne Plaza Paris Marne-la-Vallée, a new destination hotel for Crowne Plaza in France. Nestled in Magny-le-Hongre, at the heart of Marne-la-Vallée, Crowne Plaza Paris Marne-la-Vallée spans 2.5 hectares of landscaped grounds, creating a true sense of escape while remaining just moments from Paris’ world-renowned theme parks and La Vallée Village, one of Europe’s leading addresses for luxury outlet shopping.
articles.title: Crowne Plaza by IHG Hotels & Resorts expands its Paris presence with the opening of Crowne Plaza Paris Marne-la-Vallée

articles.summary: 3 September 2026, Shanghai – IHG Hotels & Resorts (IHG) is enhancing the guest journey with concert-focused hospitality solutions across Greater China, responding to the growing demand for live entertainment travel. From tailored hotel packages and convenient transport links to exclusive loyalty rewards, IHG is turning concert outings into extended travel experiences – helping guests make the most of their concert journeys beyond the venue.
articles.title: IHG Hotels & Resorts Enhances the Guest Journey with Concert-Focused Hospitality Solutions in Greater China
